targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as value FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location)

panels.title: Total Unique IPs Seen
panels.description: Count of distinct outbound IP addresses observed in the selected time range and location filter. Higher values indicate broader IP rotation across all phones.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(daily_unique), 1), 0) as value FROM (SELECT DATE(r.timestamp) as day, r.proxy_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as daily_unique FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE r.timestamp >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY DATE(r.timestamp), r.proxy_id) daily

panels.title: Avg Unique IPs / Phone / Day
panels.description: Average daily number of distinct outbound IPs per phone over the selected range. Value is unique IP count per phone per day, then averaged.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)

panels.title: Overall Uptime %
panels.description: Percentage of requests with status SUCCESS out of total requests in the selected range. 100% means every request succeeded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(s.total_requests) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)

panels.title: Total Requests in Period
panels.description: Total number of proxy test requests recorded in the selected time range and location filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as active_phones
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Unique IPs & Active Phones — Trend
panels.description: Time-series by minute: unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs seen in that minute; active_phones is distinct phones with at least one request in that minute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) AS time_sec,
  ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) AS uptime_pct
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY s.window_start
ORDER BY s.window_start

panels.title: Overall Uptime % — Trend
panels.description: Minute-level success rate over time. Each point is SUCCESS requests divided by total requests for that minute, expressed as percent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+'
       THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+'))
       ELSE 'Unknown' END                                                                      AS server,
  CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']')                                                      AS phone,
  p.location,
  SUM(s.total_requests)                                                                        AS total_requests,
  SUM(s.success_count)                                                                         AS successful,
  SUM(s.failure_count)                                                                         AS failed,
  ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2)                  AS uptime_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(s.window_start))                                                         AS active_days,
  ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS avg_response_ms
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY server, p.device_id, p.name, p.location
ORDER BY server, uptime_pct DESC

panels.title: Phone Uptime per Server
panels.description: Per-phone reliability table grouped by relay server. uptime_pct is SUCCESS/total requests; active_days is number of distinct days with activity; avg_response_ms is average latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, p.location, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as success_rate_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as failed_requests, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.download_speed_mbps > 0 THEN r.download_speed_mbps END), 2) as avg_download_mbps, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.upload_speed_mbps > 0 THEN r.upload_speed_mbps END), 2) as avg_upload_mbps, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ip_rotations_detected FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location, server ORDER BY total_requests DESC

panels.title: Traffic Stats per Phone
panels.description: Per-phone traffic and performance metrics. success_rate_pct is SUCCESS/total; unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs; avg_download_mbps and avg_upload_mbps are average measured throughput.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name as phone, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) as diversity_score_pct FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name ORDER BY diversity_score_pct DESC

panels.title: IP Diversity Score per Phone (unique IPs / total requests %)
panels.description: For each phone, diversity_score_pct = distinct outbound IPs divided by total requests, shown as percent. Higher values indicate more IP variation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT HOUR(r.timestamp) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as success_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as active_phones, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY HOUR(r.timestamp) ORDER BY hour_of_day

panels.title: Peak Hour Analysis (by Hour of Day)
panels.description: Aggregates performance by hour of day (0-23) within selected range. success_rate_pct is hourly SUCCESS ratio; active_phones and unique_ips show concurrency and IP spread.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.outbound_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as phones_sharing, COUNT(*) as total_occurrences, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name SEPARATOR ', ') as phones, MIN(r.timestamp) as first_seen, MAX(r.timestamp) as last_seen FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY r.outbound_ip HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) > 1 ORDER BY phones_sharing DESC, total_occurrences DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: IPs Shared by Multiple Phones
panels.description: Lists outbound IPs used by more than one phone in the selected period. phones_sharing is distinct phone count sharing the same IP; total_occurrences is total request rows for that IP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as uptime_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) as ip_diversity_pct, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rotations_detected, p.stability_status, p.rotation_status FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, server, p.stability_status, p.rotation_status ORDER BY uptime_pct DESC, unique_ips DESC

panels.title: Phone Reliability Ranking
panels.description: Phone ranking by uptime and IP breadth. uptime_pct is SUCCESS ratio; unique_ips and ip_diversity_pct indicate rotation variety; rotations_detected counts rows where ip_changed=1.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m') as month, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as active_phones, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as uptime_pct FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m'), server ORDER BY month DESC, server LIMIT 200

panels.title: Monthly Unique IPs per Server
panels.description: Monthly aggregation by server. unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs in that month, active_phones is number of phones active, and uptime_pct is monthly SUCCESS ratio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(r.timestamp) as day, CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, COUNT(*) as requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as uptime_pct, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY DATE(r.timestamp), p.device_id, p.name, server ORDER BY day DESC, phone LIMIT 500

panels.title: Unique IPs per Phone per Day
panels.description: Daily per-phone breakdown. unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs for the day; requests is total request count; uptime_pct is daily SUCCESS ratio; avg_response_ms is average latency.
